content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no exclusivity obligation binds AP.

Section 1 (Kubient Services) contains an affirmative non-exclusivity carve-out: *"Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."* That is stronger than our preferred position (mere silence) and preserves AP's freedom to monetize inventory through competing SSPs/agents.

The remaining "exclusive"/"sole" hits are benign or run in our favor:
- p0002 — license to AP is non-exclusive (a limit on AP's rights, not an exclusivity covenant)
- p0064 — exclusive jurisdiction/venue (dispute resolution, out of scope)
- p0065 / p0072 / p0073 — trademark ownership, entire agreement, no third-party beneficiaries

No requirements commitment, sole-supplier language, or non-compete appears; p0014 and p0062 confirm there is no minimum volume or revenue guarantee running against AP. No redline proposed.
